title: Sybase ASE database security evidence baseline
description: Declarative, read-only evidence requests for encryption, data protection, access security, and masking governance in customer-validated SAP Sybase ASE environments.

controls.title: Review encryption governance evidence
controls.objective: Require approved evidence describing encryption at rest, transport protection, key custody, backup protection, and recovery validation for the scoped SAP Sybase ASE database.

applicability.notes: No Sybase encryption probe is approved in the current collector catalog, so evidence review remains manual.

manual_evidence_requirements: Approved encryption architecture and platform scope

limitations: This control does not inspect encryption configuration and does not assert feature or license availability for a particular SAP Sybase ASE release.
Document presence alone cannot demonstrate effective encryption or successful key recovery.

remediation.guidance: Have the platform owner validate edition support, licensing, key custody, transport configuration, backup protection, recovery design, dependencies, and rollback before approving encryption changes.

controls.title: Review audit configuration metadata
controls.objective: Collect SAP Sybase ASE configuration entries associated with auditing for comparison with the approved logging, monitoring, and retention architecture.

applicability.notes: Interpret configuration values for the exact SAP Sybase ASE release, edition, and audit design.

limitations: The name-based configuration query does not demonstrate required event selection, successful delivery, retention, monitoring, storage capacity, or tamper resistance.
Configuration names and semantics may vary by supported release and require platform-owner validation.

remediation.guidance: Review required events, audit options, storage, delivery, monitoring, access controls, performance impact, and retention with the SAP Sybase ASE administrator before changing configuration.

controls.title: Review login posture metadata
controls.objective: Collect SAP Sybase ASE login status metadata so an authorized reviewer can identify candidates for ownership, lifecycle, and privileged-access analysis.

applicability.notes: Login names and full names are security metadata and require approved identity-data handling.

limitations: The probe does not collect effective role grants, object privileges, password material, authentication configuration, use history, external identity state, or business ownership.
Login metadata requires platform-specific interpretation and does not by itself establish whether access is authorized.

remediation.guidance: Correlate ownership, roles, effective privileges, recent use, service dependencies, and emergency-access requirements before following the approved login quarantine or privilege-change process.

controls.title: Review masking governance evidence
controls.objective: Require approved evidence that non-production SAP Sybase ASE data uses suitable masking techniques and that privacy, referential integrity, and application utility were validated.

applicability.notes: No masking probe is approved in the current collector catalog, so evidence review remains manual.

manual_evidence_requirements: Approved masking policy and scoped data classification
Execution record from the authorized masking mechanism

limitations: This control does not execute masking, inspect raw values, or assert feature or license availability for a particular SAP Sybase ASE release.
Document presence alone does not establish masking effectiveness; an authorized reviewer must evaluate the evidence.

remediation.guidance: Select an approved masking mechanism and execution boundary, obtain data-owner and privacy approval, validate re-identification risk and application behavior, and retain signed evidence.
